evidence.finding: Cohesive title composition, rain and wet concrete, strong teal/amber palette; readable mission invitation.
Opening critical elimination registered, full health/shield. Obvious archive markers and radar make the route legible.
West recovery presents a distinct named memory and replenishes supplies. Enemy status labels remain visible through scenery.
Heart pylon is obvious but nearby receiver needs precise approach; move-closer prompt and distance expose the distinction.
Heart recovered. Multiple sentinel/warden labels overlap world objects and the memory panel; effects further crowd the combat view.
All memories secured, clear extraction handoff with six-second hold requirement. Only opening guard eliminated; routing can bypass much combat.
Reached extraction and observed 6% uplink, 100 health and 47 shield. Incoming interceptor labels provide warning but combat direction is difficult to parse in clutter.
First death preserves all three memory names and transparent mission statistics.
Second all-three recovery confirmed with full health/shield; recovery reward is clear and generous.
Second death, three memories retained in recap; 2 phase evades registered.

blockersAndRisks: Extraction not completed in either ordinary attempt; successful ending remains unverified.
Enemy status labels can overlap each other, memory prose, gun and scenery, reducing target/direction clarity.
Large pylon and small receiver distinction caused several repositioning steps at Heart; prompt eventually resolved it.
A small roster of simple hovering/box-like opponents and repeated concrete architecture limit AAA presentation relative to the strong graphic design.
Stationary extraction was lethal after bypassing most guards. This is observed outcome, not a verified balance defect: poor combat preparation, synthetic input and latency all contributed.
limitations: Not a human realtime, hardware performance, audio quality or enjoyment proof.
Headless SwiftShader rendering and tool control differ from native mouse play.
Paused reasoning and synthetic relative look provide planning advantages while live capture/command latency can disadvantage survival.
No hidden-state inspection, fixture testing or source-freeze hash verification was performed. No game/assets modified.
